title: Cookie Notice
company: Silver Lady Holdings Ltd, trading as TMSWizzard

runs.text: This notice explains what TMSWizzard stores on, or reads from, your device. It is provided under regulation 6 of the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR).

TMSWizzard uses only cookies and browser storage that are strictly necessary to provide the service you have asked for. We use no analytics, advertising, social media or tracking cookies, no tag managers and no pixels. For that reason we do not show a cookie consent banner. The service continues to work if your browser blocks local storage, although preferences and unsaved drafts will not be remembered.

Purpose

rows: Keeps you signed in. Holds your session access token, refresh token and expiry. Refreshed as you browse, including on the public, login and signup pages.
Up to 400 days, renewed on use, removed when you sign out

Recovers an unsaved quotation after a crash or accidental close. May contain a prospect's contact details and addresses.

On a shared quotation page, records that the quotation has been opened in this tab so that one visit counts as one view and automated email scanners are not counted. It stores nothing that identifies you. It supports the delivery and acceptance record for the quotation you were sent.

runs.text: If you use a shared computer, sign out when you finish. Drafts are removed when saved, discarded, or after 7 days.

When an administrator opens the billing page to add a card, the card form is loaded from Square inside a secure frame. Square may set its own cookies and storage within that frame for payment security, 3-D Secure authentication and fraud prevention. These are strictly necessary for a payment you have chosen to make and are governed by Square's privacy notice. They are not set on any other page.

Map images are fetched by your browser directly from TomTom. TomTom receives your IP address and the area of the map being viewed. The map component stores nothing on your device and sends no telemetry.
Sharing a proof-of-delivery link through WhatsApp or opening navigation in Google Maps opens that service in a new tab under its own cookie policy.
The driver app asks for permission to use your device's location and camera. These are not cookies. They are described in our Privacy Notice.
You can delete or block cookies and site data in your browser settings. If you block the sign-in cookie you will not be able to sign in.

We do not currently use analytics. If we later introduce first-party analytics solely to improve the service, as permitted without consent under the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, we will update this notice first and provide a simple way to object. We will ask for consent before using any other non-essential cookie.
